**The evidence does not establish whether the change was illegal.** It identifies a candidate tree-cover loss of about 13.5 hectares in 2025, of which 13.1 hectares overlap areas mapped as native forest by Uruguay’s MGAP.

The observation is pending corroboration: no later year has yet been observed. It also does not establish that clearing or permanent deforestation occurred, what caused the loss, or whether any activity was authorized.

A legality determination would require corroborating the change and its cause, then checking applicable Uruguayan requirements and any permits or authorizations with the relevant authorities.
